name: AWC Cost Pricing and Purchase Orders for WooCommerce
author: Australian Web Connections

sections.description:
AWC Cost Pricing and Purchase Orders for WooCommerce extends WooCommerce with two core capabilities:

  1. Cost pricing and margin tools on products (including variations).
  2. Purchase order management for sourcing, receiving, and allocation.

Key features include:

  • Cost fields and tax mode controls for simple and variable products.
  • Live profit and margin calculator in product edit screens.
  • Purchase order creation and status tracking.
  • Supplier management with editable supplier details.
  • Add PO items by product search (name or SKU) with product image context.
  • Receive stock and track assigned vs unassigned quantities.
  • Link WooCommerce orders to purchase orders.
  • Purchase order PDF export with configurable branding/logo.
  • Analytics and margin reporting pages.
  • Admin-only PO activity log for audit trails.

This plugin requires WooCommerce to be active.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install via Plugins > Add New in WordPress.
  2. Activate AWC Cost Pricing and Purchase Orders for WooCommerce.
  3. Ensure WooCommerce is active.
  4. Go to WooCommerce > Purchase Orders to manage suppliers and POs.
  5. Edit products to add cost data and use margin calculations.
sections.faq:
Does this work with variable products?

Yes. You can store cost pricing and tax mode data per variation.

Can I search products by SKU when adding PO items?

Yes. PO item search supports product name and SKU.

Can I export a purchase order to PDF?

Yes. Each purchase order can be exported, and you can set a custom logo in PO settings.
